fact: The National University of Lesotho is compiling a Sesotho word bank to train AI systems, in a follow-up meeting with UNDP and the Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation.
The Government of Lesotho launched on 2026-07-31 the Kobong hydropower and AI data-centre project, backed by US company Convalt with about US$6.2 billion in capital investment.

A conference paper by authors at the National University of Lesotho and Botho University develops an AI diagnostic model for TB, HIV/AIDS and non-communicable diseases specific to Lesotho, reporting preliminary findings.
